messages:
sophie_csm: Weekly check-in for BlueParcel — quick error-rate breakdown for the last 7d. Focus: 5xx, client timeouts, and rate-limit spikes. TL;DR: overall error rate up to 2.9% (was 1.1% last week), main impact on embeddings pipeline and /v1/generate bursts.

ken_prod: Thanks — can you paste the top failing endpoints and the dominant error types?

sophie_csm: top failing endpoints (7d window):
- POST /v1/generate — 3,120 total 5xx, 1.6% of calls. Median latency 410ms. Biggest spikes Tue 03:10–03:40 UTC.
- POST /v1/embeddings — 980 total failures: mix of 5xx (430) and client-observed timeouts/504 (550). Patterns align with nightly bulk jobs.
- POST /v1/batch/encode — 540 timeouts (client 504) during Wed 22:00 UTC batch run.
- GET /v1/status — 240 429s (rate-limited) coinciding with BlueParcel's nightly telemetry sweep.
- POST /v1/streaming/generate — 120 intermittent 502s during region failover window.

maria_eng: quick context: embeddings failures correlate with a model swap on Tue 02:45 UTC. Kernel logs show several OOMs on node gpux-3 and queue backlog grew which led to client timeouts.

sophie_csm: Action items: @maria_eng to investigate node pool and memory footprint; @ken_prod to notify BlueParcel and provide mitigations for their batch jobs; CSM outreach scheduled 16:00 PT.

maria_eng: Investigating now — reduced embeddings batch size in staging, pulling traces from gpux-3. Starting a rolling restart of the gpux-3 pool; ETA ~90m.

opsbot: Deploy started by maria_eng at 2026-03-19T15:12:00Z — rolling restart on gpux-3 pool (3 nodes).

ken_prod: I'll send a short note to BlueParcel with suggested mitigations: lower embeddings concurrency, add exponential backoff on retries, and request they move heavy nightly jobs out of 02:00–04:00 UTC window. Also marking a follow-up sync for tomorrow.

sophie_csm: Suggested limits to include in note: embeddings concurrency <= 4, token rate cap 20k/min, batch size <= 512. Also ask them to enable client-side retry jitter.

maria_eng: Hotfix deployed to gpux-3 (reduced per-request memory reservation). Metrics update: 30m after deploy error rate dropped from 2.9% to 1.4% (ongoing monitor). Will verify long-tail latency.

sophie_csm: Awesome. I'll update the account health doc: renewal risk = low for now, but note decreased reliability for batch embeddings until they adopt throttling. Will share the health snapshot with BlueParcel during the 16:00 PT touchpoint.

ken_prod: Thanks — assign postmortem to eng if we see >10% reversion. Otherwise CSM follow-up and close. :thumbsup:

maria_eng: continuing to watch for regressions and will post logs + correlation charts in the ticket.

sophie_csm: Closing the thread for now, will reopen if anything regresses.
